bio: Hello! I'm very excited to be joining the Quincy House community this year. As House Administrator, I manage our housing lottery and room assignments, address student concerns, and oversee the financial needs of the House. I work closely with the Faculty Deans, Allston Burr Resident Dean, Resident Tutors, Academic Coordinator, and Building Manager to support the elements of house life that make Quincy House a home. Prior to joining Quincy, I served as the Program Manager for Harvard College's Advising Programs Office and the Senior Program Coordinator for the Harvard Kennedy School of Government's Public Leadership Credential program. I hold a B.A. in Psychology from Emmanuel College and an M.P.S. in Higher Education Administration from Georgetown University. In my spare time, I coach the Emmanuel College Dance Team at my alma mater. I enjoy running, crocheting, listening to true crime podcasts, and spending time with my partner, Zach and our corgi, Ollie. I live in Melrose, MA but call Rochester, NY home (Go Bills!). I hope you'll stop by my office to say hello. I look forward to meeting you soon! Community Quincy House Area Residential Life Role Residential House Administrators
